hypothesis: Quarter-pixel sampling quantization must not shrink the geometric cell's center-admissibility bound. Separate the unchanged sample grid/radius from the exact normal-line intersection with the original source cell.
policy: Opt-in only. Keep ordered128-seed budget, selected distal cell, measured axis, source pixels, profile sampling positions, margin1.5, contrast floors and branch/gap guards unchanged. No wider source cell, alternate seed, tangent or retry. A newly admissible center does not grant ownership or terminal status.
checks: Sampled profile values/offsets must be exactly unchanged between modes on the same input.
Default-mode traces must retain prior decisions.
Accepted centers stay strictly inside the original source-cell rectangle; centers outside still refuse.
Purely quantization-induced refusals may change only under the opt-in flag; all later guards remain active.
evaluation: Controlled mechanism tests first, then fixed development source14297936 in both engines. Labels used post hoc only. No held-out evaluation or threshold tuning.
